info.name: Support Desk API
info.description:
Local Support Desk backend. Start Postgres (`docker compose up -d`) and the app, then run the whole collection with the Collection Runner: each request saves the tokens the next one needs.

Seeded users (local profile, password `Password123!`): `mona` AGENT, `youssef` GUIDE_ADMIN, `nour` REVIEWER.

Full reference with every field and error code: http://localhost:8080/swagger-ui.html
